Tka Rik (Tka-Lithan Richti-Nik)

Biography

Tka Rik (Tka-Lithan Richti-Nik) is the Great Magician of Gipath and a survivor of the Joon people. His dragonet watches Zak’s journey before they meet. He explains that a Great Magician cannot leave his island, so he needs Zak to find two young Joons abroad. In return, he offers help with Zak’s lost identity. [1]

The revelation

Tka Rik shelters Lu-a-Jalla after her rescue. When Zak returns with the teleportation amulet’s remnants, he discovers that Zak himself is At-Zako. He acknowledges his mistake, restores the young man’s identity and offers to stand beside him against the Joon Curse, supplying ancient equipment for the confrontation. [2, 3, 4, 5]
